title: Equine Facilitated Psychotherapy (EFP)
summary: Intentional ground activities in the arena give Veterans space to explore real-world challenges alongside our Horse Heroes. Participants work on practical coping strategies they can carry into everyday life.
details:
Format: Weekly, ground-based sessions. No riding is involved in EAGALA-model psychotherapy.
Led by: Licensed Therapist, Equine Specialist and trained Volunteers.

title: Therapeutic Horsemanship
summary: Learn horse behavior, safety, bonding, grooming, groundwork, desensitization and lunging, with mounted activities, obstacle courses and trail work suited to each participant. Progress at your own pace while building trust, self-confidence and social skills.
details:
Format: Structured weekly units. Activities are adapted to individual goals and safety needs; riding is not guaranteed.
Led by: Certified Therapeutic Riding Instructor and trained Volunteers.

title: Pre- and Post-Deployment Support
summary: Active Duty and Reserve Service Members and their families explore resilience and coping strategies for the unique stressors of the deployment cycle.
details:
Format: Flexible one- to two-day workshops.
Led by: Licensed Therapist, Equine Specialist and trained Volunteers.

title: Family Support During Deployment
summary: Therapy and horsemanship sessions offer military families a place for stability, connection and emotional support while their loved ones are deployed.
details:
Format: Therapy and horsemanship sessions arranged with ENVET.
Led by: Licensed Therapist, Certified Therapeutic Riding Instructors and trained Volunteers.

title: Specialty Workshops
summary: Focused workshops explore grief and bereavement, Military Sexual Trauma (MST), anxiety, trust-building and social reintegration. Speak privately with the team about the focus and support that fits your goals.
details:
Format: Full-day workshops offered monthly. Confirm the next topic and date with ENVET.
Led by: Licensed Therapist, Equine Specialist and trained Volunteers.
